title: Efim Liberman's research on cytoskeletal learning

tellings.quote: liberman two friends of mine denil and David liberman their father knew uh hamov and or I think knew Penrose rather and was uh really interested in cytoskeletal learning

plain: A Soviet scientist named Efim Liberman is said to have studied cytoskeletal learning: the idea that learning happens inside the cell's internal scaffolding, not only in the connections between brain cells. Michels tells this himself, from his friends Daniil and David Liberman, Efim's sons, who told him their father knew the physicist Roger Penrose, or perhaps the researcher Stuart Hameroff. It matters because those two later argued that the brain may work on quantum principles, so Liberman would have been an early traveller on the same road.
